# TagInput

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTagInput` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasChip.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasChip.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasChip.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Tokens / tags typed into a field

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasChip](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasChip.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTagInput> CreateTagInput( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = -1);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTagInput(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTagInput(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasTagInput(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onTagsChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&)> onTagsChanged` | _Tags changed_ |
| `onTagAdded` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onTagAdded` | _Tag added_ |
| `onTagRemoved` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onTagRemoved` | _Tag removed_ |
| `validator` | `std::function<bool(const std::string&)> validator` | Return false to reject a candidate tag (e.g. failed validation). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
